title: Order submission returns HTTP 503 dependency unavailable
symptom: The portal loads, but submitting an order returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable because the inventory dependency does not respond.
user_impact: Users can open the portal but cannot submit orders. Business impact depends on whether the dependency issue affects all order submissions or only one route.
recent_changes: Inventory API deployment completed earlier the same morning.
A maintenance window for the inventory dependency ended 20 minutes before the first report.

evidence.detail: User reports the portal loads normally, but order submission fails with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable.
HTTP 503 observed on /orders/submit after clicking Submit Order.
Sample log references correlation ID sample-corr-20260707-113000-ghi789 and timeout while calling Inventory API.
Inventory API health check is failing intermittently after deployment.

operator_notes: Sample-only dependency scenario. Do not connect to real production systems.
